about_title: Grinding, deburring and finishing for the fabrication shop
about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification by a maker that exports metalworking machinery to more than 70 countries, inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel on every 3-phase machine, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

Belt grinders take the burr off a cut, blend a weld and square an end faster than a hand grinder: pedestal, floor and wide-belt grinders with 2 to 8″ belts, combination belt and disc machines, disc sanders, bench grinders and wire-wheel machines, end-surface grinders and metal dust collectors; wide-belt deburring and finishing machines for laser-cut and punched parts; corner grinders for welded boxes and frames; and edge chamfering machines for weld preps.
